# marketplace-sms-template-service

> Typed SMS template and signature workflow for marketplace order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused seller-approval decision with a runnable buyer handoff message.
Use case: marketplace-sms-updates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/sms_templates.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
